task_completion.description: Open Firefox Developer Tools to inspect the page structure.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Firefox Inspector/Developer Tools panel is visible at the bottom or side of the browser window.

task_completion.description: Delete the DOM node with ID 'overlay-ad'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'overlay-ad' element is selected in the Inspector and then disappears from the DOM tree and the page view.

task_completion.description: Delete the DOM node with ID 'cookie-banner'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'cookie-banner' element is selected in the Inspector and then disappears from the DOM tree and the page view.

task_completion.description: Disable or delete the @media print CSS block that hides content.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Style Editor or Inspector, the CSS rule containing '@media print' is either deleted, commented out, or the 'display: none' property for the content is unchecked/removed.

task_completion.description: Open the Firefox print preview/dialog to save as PDF.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Firefox Print overlay or system print dialog is visible, showing a preview of the document.

task_completion.description: Save the PDF to the specific path: /home/ga/Documents/Research/Clean_Apollo_Report.pdf
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' or 'Print to File' dialog shows the file name 'Clean_Apollo_Report.pdf' and the directory '/home/ga/Documents/Research/'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Firefox GUI and Developer Tools rather than terminal commands to edit the page.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movements and clicks within the Firefox Inspector and Style Editor, not just a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent actually modified the CSS/DOM in the browser rather than just taking a screenshot of a different file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the live removal of elements and the change in the print preview appearance within the Firefox application.

integrity.description: The agent did not use 'touch' or 'echo' in a terminal to create an empty PDF file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The PDF creation is triggered through the Firefox Print interface, not a command line prompt.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The hostile CSS block typically uses '@media print { body { display: none; } }' or similar to hide content; the agent must find this in the Style Editor or Inspector. The final PDF must be saved in the /home/ga/Documents/Research/ directory. Verification of the 'cleaned' state is best seen in the Print Preview window, where the Apollo 11 text should be visible instead of a warning message.
